question:
**Select the most appropriate ANTONYM of the given word.**

Famished
solution:
The correct answer is option "**Satiated**"

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] **__Key Points__**

__
 
• Let's look at the meaning of the given word.
 
• **Famished**: extremely hungry.
 
• Let's look at the meaning of the given options.
 
 
• **Volatile: **of a person) liable to display rapid changes of emotion.
 
• **Hesitant: **tentative, unsure, or slow in acting or speaking.
 
• **Starved: **suffer or die or cause to suffer or die from hunger.
 
• **Satiated: **to completely satisfy yourself or a need, especially with food or pleasure.
 
 
 
• As per the meaning of the given options, "**satiated**" is the antonym of "famished".
 
 
• **Example**: *She ate at the buffet until she felt **satiated**__*
 
 

Hence, the correct answer is** option 4.**

** [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/51867102c7c2f369f6e29d2efe025e3b3367c68261ec20262828d84ca5c8f854.png] __Hinglish__** 

 
• Let's look at the meaning of the given word.
 
• **Famished**:अत्यधिक भूखा।
 
• Let's look at the meaning of the given options.
 
 
• **Volatile:**** **(एक व्यक्ति की) भावना के तेजी से परिवर्तन प्रदर्शित करने के लिए उत्तरदायी।
 
• **Hesitant:**** **अस्थायी, अनिश्चित, या अभिनय या बोलने में धीमा।
 
• **Starved:**** **भुगतना या मरना या भुगतना या भूख से मरना।
 
• **Satiated:**** **अपने आप को या किसी आवश्यकता को पूरी तरह से संतुष्ट करने के लिए, विशेष रूप से भोजन या आनंद से।
 
 
 
• As per the meaning of the given options, "**satiated**" is the antonym of "famished".
